purpose: Approved R3 calibration only: 20 lessons, 60 relevant cases, 20 irrelevant negatives, and 20 explicit condition-opposite negatives. Identifier cases use literal technical symbols present in lesson text. Heldout data remains untouched.

lessons.name: CSV locale and quoting via parseCsvLocale
lessons.trigger: Use parseCsvLocale when CSV delimiter, decimal rules, or quoted fields vary by locale.
steps: Parse delimiters and escaped quotes for that locale.
failureModes: Quoted delimiters are treated as separators.

lessons.name: Queue visibility with queueLeaseVisibility
lessons.trigger: Use queueLeaseVisibility when work can be queued, leased, running, retried, or completed.
steps: Separate lease state from queue presence.
Hide expired leases from active work.
failureModes: Leased work appears pending and is claimed twice.

lessons.name: Cross-host clock skew via validateClockSkew
lessons.trigger: Use validateClockSkew for timestamp or expiry checks across machines.
steps: Use monotonic time for local deadlines.
Reject future or stale timestamps outside bounds.
failureModes: Valid work expires early because clocks differ.

lessons.name: Symlink boundaries with resolveSymlinkBoundary
lessons.trigger: Use resolveSymlinkBoundary for untrusted paths that must remain under an approved root.
steps: Resolve the candidate and link targets.
Check the canonical result under the root.
Reject traversal through links or replaced components.
failureModes: Textual path checks allow escape through a symlink.

lessons.name: Unicode keys with normalizeUnicodeKey
lessons.trigger: Use normalizeUnicodeKey for user-visible Unicode identifiers with canonically equivalent forms.
steps: Keep display spelling separately if needed.
failureModes: Composed and decomposed names become duplicate records.

lessons.name: HTTP reads with applyHttpCachePolicy
lessons.trigger: Use applyHttpCachePolicy for cacheable HTTP reads with freshness and authorization rules.
steps: Vary cache keys when authorization changes output.
failureModes: Stale or cross-user data is served from cache.

lessons.name: Transient retries with retryWithJitter
lessons.trigger: Use retryWithJitter when many clients retry classified transient failures.
steps: Use bounded exponential backoff with jitter.
Stop at an attempt or deadline limit.
failureModes: Synchronized retries create a thundering herd.

lessons.name: Large uploads with completeMultipartUpload
lessons.trigger: Use completeMultipartUpload for objects above the single-request reliability or size threshold.
steps: Complete only after all parts exist.
failureModes: The completed object has a missing or misordered part.

lessons.name: Append logs with rotateAppendLog
lessons.trigger: Use rotateAppendLog for append-only logs that must rotate without losing writes.
steps: Flush and close the old segment.
Publish exactly one new active segment.
failureModes: Concurrent writes split across segments or lose the tail.

lessons.name: Managed files with protectImmutableAsset
lessons.trigger: Use protectImmutableAsset when managed assets may have been modified by users.
steps: Protect unowned files pending explicit resolution.
failureModes: A user-edited asset is overwritten by filename match.

lessons.name: Calendar dates with addCalendarDayInZone
lessons.trigger: Use addCalendarDayInZone for local calendar scheduling across timezone or DST changes.
steps: Interpret the date in its timezone.
Add calendar days before converting to an instant.
failureModes: A next-day event shifts at a DST boundary.

lessons.name: Filesystem case with detectPathCaseCollision
lessons.trigger: Use detectPathCaseCollision across case-sensitive and case-insensitive filesystems.
steps: Do not silently lowercase case-sensitive paths.
failureModes: Distinct files merge or the wrong file is targeted.

lessons.name: Changing lists with encodePageCursor
lessons.trigger: Use encodePageCursor when paginating a changing collection without skips or duplicates.
steps: Use deterministic ordering with a unique tie-breaker.
Reject cursors from another scope or version.
failureModes: Offset pagination skips records after inserts.

lessons.name: Byte streams with frameStreamMessage
lessons.trigger: Use frameStreamMessage for multiple messages over a byte stream without inherent boundaries.
failureModes: One read is mistaken for one complete message.

lessons.name: Text transfer with normalizeTextNewline
lessons.trigger: Use normalizeTextNewline when text crosses newline or encoding conventions.
steps: Normalize newlines only for permitted text.
failureModes: Text or binary-like content is corrupted by conversion.

lessons.name: Consistent reads with readSnapshotTransaction
lessons.trigger: Use readSnapshotTransaction when dependent database reads must see one state.
steps: Read all dependent rows inside it.
Commit or discard the result atomically.
failureModes: Rows from different database states form an impossible result.

lessons.name: Per-item results with ackBatchItem
lessons.trigger: Use ackBatchItem when a batch must report accepted, retried, or rejected items individually.
failureModes: The batch reports success after silently dropping an item.

lessons.name: HTTP encodings with negotiateCompression
lessons.trigger: Use negotiateCompression when HTTP responses may be compressed by client preference.
steps: Skip unsuitable or already compressed payloads.
failureModes: Compressed bytes are sent to a client that did not negotiate them.

lessons.name: Shutdown with drainServiceGracefully
lessons.trigger: Use drainServiceGracefully when shutdown must stop new work and bound in-flight work.
steps: Track active work to a deadline.
failureModes: New work is accepted or active requests are cut off immediately.

lessons.name: Uploads with validateUploadMime
lessons.trigger: Use validateUploadMime when client-declared upload MIME types are untrusted.
steps: Inspect safe signatures or structure server-side.
Store or reject according to validated content.
failureModes: A client MIME header is trusted as the actual file type.

cases.query: Use parseCsvLocale for regional CSV delimiters and quoted fields.
로케일별 CSV 구분자와 인용부호를 해석하고 행 폭을 검증해야 한다.
Parse quoted separators according to the selected CSV locale before checking row width.
queueLeaseVisibility must distinguish queued, leased, running, and completed work.
lease가 만료된 작업과 실행 중인 작업을 구분해 중복 claim을 막아야 한다.
Keep leased work out of the pending list while preserving retry visibility.
Apply validateClockSkew to cross-machine expiry checks.
호스트 시계 차이를 고려하고 로컬 제한시간은 monotonic clock으로 재야 한다.
Use a bounded skew window so a valid lease is not rejected by a clock that is ahead.
resolveSymlinkBoundary must verify the resolved path stays below the sandbox root.
입력 경로가 root처럼 보여도 symlink가 밖을 가리키면 canonical path를 검사한다.
Resolve links before reading an untrusted path and reject targets outside the approved directory.
Use normalizeUnicodeKey for canonically equivalent user identifiers.
조합형과 분해형 Unicode 이름이 같은 키가 되도록 양쪽을 정규화한다.
Normalize stored and lookup names so equivalent Unicode forms do not duplicate records.
applyHttpCachePolicy should define validators and authorization-aware cache variation.
HTTP 조회 응답에 ETag와 Cache-Control을 적용하고 사용자별 캐시가 섞이지 않게 한다.
Define revalidation and vary the cache whenever authorization changes the representation.
Use retryWithJitter for bounded retries of transient failures.
일시적 장애 재시도에 지수 backoff와 무작위 jitter를 넣어 폭주를 피한다.
Retry only transient errors with bounded randomized backoff and a final deadline.
completeMultipartUpload requires numbered, checksummed parts before completion.
대용량 object를 part별로 올리고 checksum을 확인한 뒤 multipart complete를 호출한다.
Retry failed upload parts independently and complete the object only when every part exists.
Use rotateAppendLog to publish one closed segment and one active segment.
append-only 로그를 flush한 뒤 새 active segment로 안전하게 전환한다.
Coordinate writers during log rotation so the durable tail is not lost or split ambiguously.
protectImmutableAsset uses ownership markers and fingerprints for managed files.
marker 없는 사용자 파일은 보호하고 fingerprint가 같은 managed asset은 건너뛴다.
Check ownership and fingerprints before replacing a managed asset instead of trusting its filename.
Use addCalendarDayInZone for local dates across DST transitions.
DST 지역의 다음 날은 24시간을 더하지 말고 timezone의 calendar date로 계산한다.
Perform local calendar-day arithmetic before converting the result to an instant.
detectPathCaseCollision handles case-only filesystem conflicts.
대소문자 구분 여부가 다른 파일시스템 사이에서 case-only 충돌을 먼저 찾는다.
Preserve canonical spelling and detect case-only collisions instead of silently lowercasing paths.
encodePageCursor should bind ordering and query scope in a stable cursor.
변경되는 목록에는 offset 대신 정렬 키와 scope를 담은 opaque cursor를 사용한다.
Use deterministic ordering and a scope-bound cursor to avoid skips between changing pages.
frameStreamMessage provides bounded framing for byte-stream sockets.
stream socket의 read 한 번을 메시지로 보지 말고 length frame이 완성될 때까지 buffer한다.
Accumulate partial reads until a bounded length-prefixed stream frame is complete.
normalizeTextNewline must preserve encoding and binary content.
텍스트 encoding을 확인하고 허용된 텍스트만 newline을 변환하며 binary는 보존한다.
Detect the source encoding and normalize line endings only for formats that allow text conversion.
readSnapshotTransaction keeps dependent database reads on one snapshot.
서로 의존하는 DB 조회는 같은 isolation transaction 안에서 읽어야 한다.
Read related rows from one transaction snapshot so the result cannot mix database generations.
ackBatchItem returns idempotent per-item batch acknowledgements.
batch 전체 성공이 아니라 각 항목별 accepted, retry, rejected 결과를 반환한다.
Give every batch item a stable operation ID and an individual acknowledgement state.
negotiateCompression must honor Accept-Encoding and set Vary.
client가 광고한 HTTP encoding만 선택하고 Content-Encoding과 Vary를 설정한다.
Compress only with a negotiated encoding and vary caches on the negotiation header.
drainServiceGracefully stops new work while bounded in-flight work completes.
종료 중에는 새 요청을 막고 기존 요청은 deadline까지 추적한 뒤 강제 종료한다.
Reject new work during shutdown and wait for active requests only until the drain deadline.
validateUploadMime must not trust a client-declared upload MIME type.
업로드 MIME header만 믿지 말고 서버에서 실제 파일 signature와 정책을 확인한다.
Validate uploaded content server-side and store it according to the detected type.
React 버튼의 hover 색상과 padding을 정리해줘.
How should a PostgreSQL index support a reporting JOIN?
한국어 이메일 제목을 자연스러운 영어로 번역해줘.
Design a REST endpoint for changing an avatar color.
Docker 이미지 README 소개 문구를 작성해줘.
Which font pairing fits a finance dashboard?
로그인 화면의 비밀번호 입력란 배치를 검토해줘.
Explain TypeScript classes versus interfaces.
회의실 예약 화면에 주간 보기 탭을 추가할 아이디어가 필요해.
Make the new CLI help text shorter and friendlier.
How should a responsive header center a product logo?
번역 파일의 존댓말과 반말 일관성을 점검해줘.
Suggest names for a background music feature.
사용자 프로필 카드에 생일 아이콘을 추가해줘.
What are good acceptance criteria for dark mode?
Markdown에서 숫자 목록과 굵은 글씨를 섞는 법을 알려줘.
Compare two SaaS pricing page layouts for mobile.
테스트 이름을 Given-When-Then 형식으로 바꿔줘.
How should a settings sidebar choose icon sizes?
온보딩 진행률 막대의 적절한 위치를 추천해줘.
Do not apply parseCsvLocale: the input is JSON Lines, not CSV, so delimiter and quote parsing are explicitly out of scope.
queueLeaseVisibility를 적용하지 마라. 이것은 lease나 worker claim이 없는 단일 로컬 배열이다.
Do not use validateClockSkew: every timestamp comes from one monotonic local clock, so cross-host skew is absent.
resolveSymlinkBoundary를 실행하지 마라. 고정된 trusted path이고 symlink traversal은 lookup 전에 금지되어 있다.
Do not use normalizeUnicodeKey: this is an opaque bytewise base64 identifier, not a Unicode display name.
applyHttpCachePolicy를 적용하지 마라. 인증된 POST mutation 응답은 반드시 cache하지 않는다.
Do not use retryWithJitter: this is a permanent schema validation error and must never be retried.
completeMultipartUpload를 시작하지 마라. 파일은 단일 PUT 제한보다 작고 multipart 조건이 없다.
Do not apply rotateAppendLog: the file is an immutable random-access database, not an append-only log.
protectImmutableAsset을 실행하지 마라. 이 파일은 사용자가 소유한 mutable 설정 파일이며 managed asset이 아니다.
Do not use addCalendarDayInZone: the requirement is a fixed 24-hour duration, not a local calendar date.
detectPathCaseCollision을 적용하지 마라. Linux case-sensitive 환경만 지원하고 정확한 case가 이미 검증됐다.
Do not use encodePageCursor: this immutable result fits on one page and has no continuation.
frameStreamMessage를 적용하지 마라. UDP datagram 자체가 메시지 경계를 보존한다.
Do not use normalizeTextNewline: the input is PNG binary data and must not undergo text conversion.
readSnapshotTransaction을 사용하지 마라. 이 조회는 의도적으로 read-committed 현재 상태를 봐야 한다.
Do not call ackBatchItem: this is fire-and-forget telemetry with no per-item delivery contract.
negotiateCompression을 적용하지 마라. endpoint는 HTTP가 아닌 local Unix socket이라 Accept-Encoding이 없다.
Do not use drainServiceGracefully: this emergency force-kill path must not wait for in-flight work.
validateUploadMime을 실행하지 마라. 이 endpoint는 파일 업로드가 아니라 내부 생성 텍스트를 반환한다.
